exposure: Balloon occlusion combined with uterine artery embolization
outcome: Postoperative coagulation function (thrombin time, fibrinogen, activated partial thromboplastin time, prothrombin time)
cohort: 38 patients with high-risk placenta previa undergoing cesarean section
finding: The combined approach of balloon occlusion and uterine artery embolization improved coagulation function and reduced blood loss, plasma injection volume, and hospital stay in patients with high-risk placenta previa undergoing cesarean section compared to conventional cesarean section.
mod_finding: The combined approach of balloon occlusion and uterine artery embolization during cesarean section in patients with high-risk placenta previa was shown to improve coagulation function and reduce blood loss and plasma injection.
